hero.headline: Your business, fully supported. Your team, always ready.
hero.sub_headline: Ottobon Professional Services handles the operational weight so your core team can focus on what actually moves the needle — delivered by expert humans, powered by AI.

positioning.quote: We are not a staffing agency. We are not a software tool. We are the operational backbone your business didn't know it was missing.

pillars.heading: Two ways we support your business

items.title: People & Talent
items.tagline: Get the right people doing the right work — tracked, accountable, and delivered.
items.description: Whether you have an idea that needs to become a product, or a growing team that needs qualified talent fast — we put the right people in place. And with our built-in task management layer, you always know exactly what's happening, no matter where in the world your team sits.

items.title: Business Operations
items.tagline: Stop running your business on the side. Let us run the back-office.
items.description: Finance. Legal. Sales. Compliance. These are the departments every business needs but few early-stage companies can afford to build in-house. We handle all of it — so you don't have to.

detailed_services.label: Business Development
detailed_services.headline: We fill your pipeline. You close the deals.
detailed_services.body: From market research and lead generation to pre-sales support and pitch preparation — our BD team works as an extension of your own sales function. We don't just hand you leads; we build the foundation for sustainable growth.

detailed_services.label: Operation Support
detailed_services.headline: The operational layer your team is missing.
detailed_services.body: Running a consulting practice or a growing startup means constant coordination — managing people, tracking work, and keeping quality consistent. Our TalentOps function handles all of that behind the scenes, so your delivery never slips.

detailed_services.label: Execution Support
detailed_services.headline: From idea to team to product — we make it real.
detailed_services.body: This is the heart of our people-side offering. Two distinct models:

sub_sections.title: Contract & Full-Time Hiring
bullets: Source, vet, and place qualified talent
Available on hourly contracts or as full-time hires
Built-in task management and complete work visibility

sub_sections.title: MVP / Idea to Prototype
bullets: Turn concepts into working prototypes at a fixed price
Clear scope defined upfront with no surprises
Delivered strictly on time by expert technical teams

detailed_services.quote: Think of it as: you bring the vision, we build the engine.

detailed_services.label: Legal, Finance & Regulatory
detailed_services.headline: Stay legal. Stay Compliant. Stay operational.
detailed_services.body: From tax filings and payroll to corporate compliance and regulatory frameworks — we ensure your business is always on the right side of the law and built to withstand pressure. This is the unsexy work that quietly keeps everything else running.

secret_sauce.heading: Human expertise. AI efficiency. Full transparency.
secret_sauce.body: Every service we offer is delivered through a modern two-layer model — experienced professionals backed by AI tools that accelerate output, improve accuracy, and reduce cost. And across all talent engagements, our task management infrastructure gives clients real-time visibility into what's being done, by whom, and when.
